summary_en: Interim dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027: ordinary dividend 21 yen per share, special dividend 15 yen per share, total 36 yen per share. Special dividend of 15 yen per share will continue in the final dividend. Company maintains policy of special dividend at 30 yen per share annually through fiscal year ending March 2029.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend (Ordinary Dividend and Special Dividend) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Marusan Securities announced its interim dividend plan for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The company will pay an ordinary dividend of 21 yen per share and a special dividend of 15 yen per share, for a total interim dividend of 36 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026. The company has committed to an annual special dividend of 30 yen per share (15 yen at interim and 15 yen at year-end) continuing through the fiscal year ending March 2029, as previously announced in September 2023 and July 2026.

The company stated its ordinary dividend policy targets a payout ratio of 50% or more of net income, while strengthening internal reserves to enhance financial stability. The special dividend is part of the company's enhanced shareholder return policy to express appreciation for shareholder support. The company emphasized that this approach supports its medium-term management plan targets, specifically aiming to achieve an ROE of 8%. Final confirmation of the interim dividend amounts is scheduled for the board meeting in late October 2026.
